items.title: 15.1 Methods of separation of mixtures (mixtures alag karne ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.1 (Methods of Separation of Mixtures), printed page 324.

blocks.text: Mixture ke components (hisse) neeche diye gaye kisi bhi physical method (tareeqe) se alag kiye ja sakte hain:

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Physical method mein koi nayi substance nahi banti; sirf mixture ke hisse ek doosre se alag ho jate hain. Har tareeqa agle topics mein detail se aata hai.

blocks.caption: Paanch tareeqe
rows: liquid ya solution se woh solid jo hal nahi hota
hal hone wala solid us ki impurities (milawat) se
do aise liquids jo aapas mein mil jate hain (miscible), jin ke boiling points alag hon
chhote sample mein hal hone wali substances

items: Mixture alag karne ke paanch physical tareeqe: filtration, crystallization, simple distillation, fractional distillation, paper chromatography.
